title: nesirli/na12878-variant-calling pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. When --download_reads is true (default) only 'sample' is required; otherwise fastq_1 (and optionally fastq_2) must point to existing FASTQ files.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 (only used when --download_reads false)

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 (only used when --download_reads false)
